Northern Ireland logistics services firm SJH Fulfilment has announced a £3.5 million investment in a new 46,000 sq ft Greater Belfast fulfilment facility, more than doubling its total warehousing footprint and supporting 25 permanent jobs at the site within the next three years.

Members of SJH Fulfilment’s leadership team pictured at the company’s new Greater Belfast facility are Stephen Henderson, founder and CEO; Elizabeth McConville, head of customer success, Stephen Laird, chief operating officer and Kathryn Henderson, head of finance. results.author: Sumit Vishwakarma
results.text:
US delivery platform DoorDash opens Hyderabad hub, plans to grow workforce to over 3,000 in two years

# US delivery platform DoorDash opens Hyderabad hub, plans to grow workforce to over 3,000 in two years 

Sumit Vishwakarma

 30 Sep 2026 19:30 IST

US-based local commerce platform DoorDash has opened a new talent hub in Hyderabad, with plans to increase its workforce at the facility from 500 to more than 3,000 over the next two years.

The hub, located in Hitec City, will initially house the company's Customer Experience and Integrity (CXI) and General and Administrative (G&A) teams and support DoorDash's global operations.

Telangana IT and Industries Minister D Sridhar Babu inaugurated the facility alongside DoorDash Chief Financial Officer Ravi Inukonda, Senior Director of Workforce Strategy and Talent Acquisition Operations Jenna Kohnke, and Telangana government IT Advisor Sai Krishna.

The Hyderabad operation will be DoorDash's third internal CXI service centre globally, alongside existing centres in Tempe, Arizona, and Mexico City.

Evri invests £1.3m in new Gloucester parcel depot - FleetPoint

# Evri invests £1.3m in new Gloucester parcel depot

 October 12, 2026 Mark Salisbury Filed under: Last Mile Deliveries, Logistics, Manufacturer News, News, Newsletter, Secondary News, Third-Party Logistics (3PL) 

Evri Group has opened a new £1.3 million depot in Gloucester, expanding its parcel delivery network across the South West and creating dozens of permanent jobs.

The new facility at Indurent Park Gloucester in Quedgeley replaces the company’s previous operation in Tewkesbury, which had reached capacity. The investment will help Evri manage rising parcel volumes, strengthen regional operations and improve its ability to meet customer demand.

The depot has created 38 permanent roles across warehouse, driving, operational and management functions. The investment also supports local employment while providing additional capacity for the growing logistics business.

Image: Evri
